'''Trixie''' (Japanese: '''ヒバリ''' ''Hibari'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP153|Love, Totodile Style]]''. She and her Pokémon are performers in a Pokémon circus.

Trixie met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} while she was out looking for her lost {{p|Azumarill}}. After finding Azumarill, she informed the group that the Aqua Rabbit Pokémon had recently been behaving oddly, even refusing to perform in the circus, which deeply concerned her. She then invited everyone to her next circus performance, but it was interrupted by [[Ash's Totodile]], who had fallen fell in love with Azumarill, who in turn wanted nothing to do with him.

After {{TRT}} kidnapped Azumarill and Totodile, Trixie had her {{p|Pidgey}} locate [[Team Rocket's mechas|Team Rocket's balloon]]. During the ensuing confrontation, Ash's Pokémon set the captives free. Azumarill finally expressed her love for Trixie's {{p|Golduck}}, which had been what was responsible for her behavioral change, much to the surprise of everyone.

|desc=Trixie's {{p|Azumarill}} is the main star of her circus performances. She wears a distinct pink bow on her tail. [[Ash's Totodile]] was out swimming in a lake when he overheard Azumarill's singing. He developed a crush on Azumarill, but none of Totodile's expressions of love impressed her.

Trixie noticed that Azumarill had been behaving differently, even refusing to perform, since {{p|Golduck}} had joined the circus troupe. Her diva behavior continued when she stormed off-stage during her ball-juggling water performance, mainly because Totodile had leaped onto the stage.

Later, Azumarill was captured by {{TRT}}. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} tried to help it, but {{AP|Pikachu}} was captured too. Team Rocket tried to get her to juggle, but she refused their pleas. Suddenly, Totodile appeared but was captured too. At night, Totodile gave Azumarill her lost ribbon back, making her slightly happy. The next day, Ash and his friends found Team Rocket, and Trixie's Golduck was able to send them blasting off with a powerful Water Gun. Azumarill was freed from her cage, and it ran towards Golduck, dodging Totodile and hugging Golduck instead. Trixie understood that Azumarill had developed strong feelings of affection for Golduck, and soon after, Azumarill returned to her normal self.

In the English version, Azumarill was repeatedly referred to as a female.

Azumarill's only known move is {{m|Water Gun}}.}}
